data.title: Court payment order (Mahnbescheid) from Amtsgericht Exempelbrück
data.summary: The Zentrales Mahngericht at Amtsgericht Exempelbrück issued a court payment order (Mahnbescheid), case number 26-5531904-0-7, on behalf of Beispielfunk Mobilnetz GmbH, claiming a total of €272.49 (including €214.37 for mobile phone charges from June to August 2026, plus interest and costs). It was delivered to the letterbox on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is a formal court order claiming you owe money; the court itself has not checked whether the claim is justified. You have two options: pay the total amount to the claimant if you agree the debt is owed, or send the enclosed form back to the court objecting (Widerspruch) if you dispute it, fully or in part. The app shows the deadline for both options based on the delivery date. If neither payment nor an objection arrives in time, the company can ask the court for an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) and start collecting the debt by force. Given the legal and financial weight, consider contacting a consumer advice centre or lawyer if you disagree with the claim.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the claim
items.action: If you disagree with the claim, send the enclosed objection form (Widerspruch) back to the court within the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If neither payment nor an objection arrives in time, the claimant can request an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) and start compulsory enforcement against you.
items.quote: Ihnen bleiben zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung. In dieser Zeit sollen Sie den Gesamtbetrag nebst weiteren Zinsen an die Antragstellerin zahlen, wenn Sie die Forderung für berechtigt halten, oder dem Gericht auf dem beigefügten Vordruck mitteilen, ob und wie weit Sie Widerspruch erheben.
